official.deadline_central_display: October 6, 2026, 1:00 p.m. Pacific Time (2027 cohort - now closed)
official.deadline_note: The Stanford graduate degree program application is separate and due by the earlier of the program's KHS deadline or December 1, 2026; the KHS application for the 2028 cohort opens in summer 2027.
official.status_note: The official application deadlines page states: 'The KHS application to join the 2027 cohort is now closed. The KHS application to join the 2028 cohort will open in summer 2027.'
official.tuition_coverage_note: Scholars receive a fellowship applied directly to cover tuition and associated fees, for up to three years depending on degree length.
official.funding_period: up to three years of funding
benefits: A fellowship applied directly to cover tuition and associated fees
A stipend for living and academic expenses (such as room and board, books, academic supplies, instructional materials, local transportation, and reasonable personal expenses)
A travel stipend intended to cover an economy-class ticket for one annual trip to and from Stanford
A one-time relocation stipend for newly enrolling scholars
Supplemental funds for academic enrichment activities (e.g., conference travel) available to scholars in their second and third years
eligibility: Citizens and residents of all countries are encouraged to apply; no restrictions based on age, college or university, field of study, or career aspiration
Must apply to, be accepted by, and enroll in a full-time Stanford graduate degree program, starting KHS in the same year
Must have earned a U.S. bachelor's degree or its equivalent in January 2020 or later (2027 cohort; military service extends the window to January 2018 or later)
No institutional endorsements required; no quotas by discipline, program, or world region
Some Stanford programs are not eligible, including the Honors Cooperative Program, Master of Liberal Arts, JSD, and MLS
requirements: Submit the KHS application by October 6, 2026, 1:00 p.m. Pacific Time (2027 cohort deadline)
Submit a completely separate Stanford graduate degree program application by the earlier of the program's KHS deadline or December 1, 2026
MBA applicants must submit by the MBA Round 1 deadline to remain eligible for KHS
KHS charges no application fee and cannot provide degree-program application fee waivers
documents: Separate Stanford graduate degree program application
Finalist experience (if selected as a finalist)
selection_criteria: No formula for admission; applicants are evaluated on independence of thought, purposeful leadership, and a civic mindset
Video statement invitations are sent on a rolling basis
Finalists participate in the Finalist Experience
coverage: Tuition and associated fees for up to three years
Stipend for living and academic expenses
Economy-class ticket for one annual trip to and from Stanford
One-time relocation stipend for newly enrolling scholars
application_method: Submit separate but concurrent applications: one to Knight-Hennessy Scholars and one to the Stanford graduate degree program(s)
official.application_route: Submit the KHS application by the single October deadline and a separate Stanford graduate application by the earlier of the program's KHS deadline or December 1; each cohort's application opens in summer.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to citizens and residents of all countries; no nationality restrictions
official.international_eligibility: Yes - applicants from all countries are eligible and scholars come from around the globe
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No restrictions by field of study; funding applies to full-time graduate degree programs across Stanford's seven schools, excluding certain programs (e.g., Honors Cooperative Program, Master of Liberal Arts, JSD, MLS)
official.duration: Up to three years of funding, depending on degree length; for degrees exceeding three years (such as MD or PhD), funding beyond year three is based on the degree program's standard funding commitment
official.description: Knight-Hennessy Scholars is a fully-endowed, multidisciplinary leadership development program for graduate students at Stanford University; scholars receive up to three years of financial support to pursue graduate studies at any of Stanford's seven schools while engaging in experiences that prepare them to be visionary, courageous, and collaborative leaders.
official.program_type: Graduate leadership fellowship funding full-time Stanford graduate degree study

verification.notes: Stanford's funding, deadlines, and eligibility pages confirm coverage components and cycle status: the 2027 cohort application closed October 6, 2026, 1:00 p.m. PT, and the 2028 cohort application opens in summer 2027. No dollar figure is published for the fellowship.

applicant_utility.summary: Timing is the whole game here: the KHS deadline is a single hard date for everyone (October 6, 1:00 p.m. PT for the 2027 cohort), and your Stanford degree application must be in by the earlier of the program's KHS deadline or December 1 - miss that and you can still attend Stanford, just not as a scholar. You must apply twice, concurrently, and MBA applicants have to use Round 1. For the 2028 cycle, watch for the application to open in summer 2027 and start essay and recommender prep months earlier, because recommendation letters can follow the deadline but your own submission cannot.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent graduates (bachelor's earned January 2020 or later) headed to a full-time Stanford graduate program who can evidence independence of thought, purposeful leadership, and civic impact.
application_readiness_checklist: Map both applications early: KHS by the single October deadline, Stanford by the earlier of the program's KHS deadline or December 1
MBA applicants: target Round 1 specifically, since only Round 1 aligns with the KHS timeline
Draft the short answers and essay around independence of thought, purposeful leadership, and civic mindset - the three published criteria
Brief recommenders so letters land even if slightly after your on-time submission
Confirm your degree program is KHS-eligible (the Honors Cooperative Program, MLA, JSD, and MLS are not)
common_rejection_risks: Submitting the Stanford degree application after December 1 or after the program's KHS deadline - this forfeits KHS eligibility while leaving graduate admission intact
Treating KHS as an application to complete later - the two must be concurrent
Essays that recite achievements without evidence of independent thinking or civic contribution
Degree recency rule: a bachelor's earned before January 2020 (January 2018 with military service) disqualifies you regardless of later degrees
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Fellowship stipends are taxable and Knight-Hennessy Scholars does not reimburse taxes; scholars should budget for their own tax liability.
document_audit: Two separate applications with two different deadlines - one portal does not feed the other
Recommendation letters and test scores may arrive after the KHS deadline as long as your own application is submitted on time
KHS has no application fee, but you still pay the Stanford degree program's fee - KHS cannot waive it
alerts: The 2027 cohort application closed October 6, 2026; the 2028 application opens in summer 2027
KHS does not defer scholar offers - if you cannot enroll, you must reapply
For MD, PhD, and dual-degree programs longer than three years, funding beyond year three depends on the department's standard commitment, not KHS
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: KHS application by the October deadline + separate Stanford degree application by the earlier KHS/deadline or December 1 -> rolling video statement invitations -> finalist experience -> scholar notifications in the spring for the following year's cohort.
